verdict.rationale: Figma documents an AI agent that generates design directions, diagrams, and can summarize/search data within files (figma-docs-17, figma-docs-34, figma-docs-42, figma-docs-51), and a community anecdote confirms real-world use for data summarization (figma-comm-9). However, independent community feedback specifically calls out that 'the AI tools in FigJam are really bad and often broken' (figma-comm-8), directly contradicting the vendor's polish claims for these AI-insight features. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks or broader hands-on validation showing consistent reliability of AI-generated insights across Figma's core design surface, not just FigJam.
